messages:
kim-nguyen: Hey, FYI merchant m_7890 is seeing a surge of card declines since 03:04 UTC. Customers report AVS/CVV mismatch errors. Sample response from our API:

```
{
  "id": "txn_01H7x2L9",
  "status": "declined",
  "decline_code": "X31",
  "avs_result": "N",
  "cvv_result": "N",
  "issuer_message": "AVS/CVV mismatch - verify cardholder"
}
```

Request billing object looks normal (addresses provided). Passing along a couple of last4: 4242, 4012. Can someone help triage?

rafael-ortiz: thanks. can you paste the raw request headers + body (remove PAN), and one full response log line with the acquirer id? need to see acquirer_reply_code and acquirer name. also which region this merchant is in.

kim-nguyen: pasted below (sanitized). acquirer: AcmePay, acquirer_code: ACQ_011, region: eu-west-1.

```
POST /v1/payments
headers: { Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX, Content-Type: application/json }
body: {
  "merchant_id": "m_7890",
  "amount": 12500,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "card": { "last4": "4242", "exp_month": 12, "exp_year": 2027 },
  "billing_address": { "line1": "12 Rue de l'Église", "city": "Nantes", "postal_code": "44000", "country": "FR" }
}
```

response snippet: `{status: "declined", acquirer_reply: "AVS MISMATCH", acquirer_code: "X31"}`

amy-chen: is this affecting one BIN range or broad? merchant says 17% of attempts in last 2 hours. could be AcmePay tightened AVS rules or we rolled out a validation change. kim, did we change the AVS normalization for fr addresses recently?

kim-nguyen: Not on our side. No AVS normalization deploys in last 24h. I checked the release log.

samir: payments-infra here. I pulled merchant config: m_7890 has `avs_block: true` and `require_cvv: true` enabled at acquirer routing layer. If AcmePay started returning N for avs, our routing will block immediately. Can we get 3 sample transaction IDs and timestamps to open a ticket with Acme?

kim-nguyen: txn_01H7x2L9 (1793024021), txn_01H7x9B3 (1793024088), txn_01H7y0P2 (1793024505). sending logs via secure paste to acme-pay-ops.

payments-bot: Ticket created: ACME-7892 linking merchant m_7890 transactions [txn_01H7x2L9, txn_01H7x9B3, txn_01H7y0P2]. Assigned to AcmePay Ops. ETA 4-8h.

rafael-ortiz: short-term mitigation: samir, can we flip `avs_block` to false for this merchant while we investigate? That will let non-matching AVS through (still flagged). We should require 3DS for amounts > 50 EUR as extra protection. Thoughts?

samir: I can toggle avs_block to false on the routing tier for m_7890. Will add a note and a 24h auto-rollback. I also recommend enabling `require_3ds` on the merchant profile for high-risk txns. I'll patch now and monitor.

kim-nguyen: please do. merchant approved temporary change.

samir: Done: `avs_block=false` for m_7890 at 1793024802. 24h rollback timer set. Monitoring for chargebacks and fraud signals.

acme-pay-ops: AcmePay acked ticket ACME-7892. Preliminary response: we started stricter AVS matching for FR addresses due to fraud spike. They returned `X31` when locality/line1 don't match normalized record. They're investigating normalization rules; suspect accent/abbrev handling.

amy-chen: Good catch. For long-term: we should add an AVS normalization pass for common French characters/abbreviations and add a fallback path that requests 3DS on AVS failures for EU merchants. Adding to payments roadmap.

rafael-ortiz: action items: 1) samir toggled avs_block=false (done). 2) kim to send merchant comms + monitoring dashboard link. 3) payments team to add FR AVS normalization ticket and 3DS fallback. 4) keep ACME ticket open until normalized (ACME-7892).

kim-nguyen: I'll notify merchant and share dashboard. Also added a support note about the temporary change.

payments-bot: Monitoring alert: approval rate for m_7890 increased from 83% -> 94% after toggle. No immediate fraud indicators. Alert will continue for 24h.

samir: I'll follow up with risk & SRE in 6h for a deeper review.

kim-nguyen: thanks everyone. marking as in-progress until Acme closes their ticket.

acme-pay-ops: Update at 1793025100: Acme found address normalization mismatch for abbreviations ("Ste" vs "St") and will deploy a fix to their matcher in 12-24h. They request merchants to keep avs_block relaxed until then.

rafael-ortiz: perfect. once acme confirms deploy and we monitor for 48h, we can re-enable avs_block. leaving thread open. :white_check_mark:
